origin.birthplace: The village of Hemsby by the forest
origin.socialStatus: A craftsman, respected in the village community
origin.profession: A smith all his life, son of a smith

appearance.face: A ruddy face, burns on his arms and neck, a small scar on the chin
appearance.hairAndEyes: Bald, red beard, dark watchful eyes
appearance.clothing: A leather apron, a coarse wool shirt, heavy boots, smith's tongs on his belt
appearance.gestures: Scratches his beard when thinking; drums his fingers on the table like a hammer
appearance.voice: Deep, slow voice with a country accent
appearance.firstImpression: A simple but reliable man who is not impressed by titles
appearance.artistNotes: Wears a small horseshoe amulet. His hands are dark with soot that never washes off.

backstory.biography: Oswin has spent his whole life in his father's forge, making horseshoes, tools and armour for anyone who pays honestly. Once a travelling merchant cheated him with rotten iron, and since then he distrusts smooth talk. Now the village is crushed by taxes and his son is ill and needs expensive treatment.
backstory.whyHere: Not for riches, but to pay for his son's treatment. Someone told him courage "pays well" here.
backstory.secret: He hides little. He does not say how desperately he needs the money.

psychology.weakness: Does not understand political games and does not see complex traps
psychology.fear: That his son dies because of his failure
psychology.regret: Little. It hurts that work kept him from his son's side
psychology.moralLimits: Does not steal, lie or hurt
psychology.wouldForReward: Risk everything if it saves his son

behavior.stakes: Small, honest stakes. Big only if he must
behavior.deception: Does not cheat. Does not trust those who do
behavior.alliances: Slow to ally, but stays loyal
behavior.whenAttacks: When he is sure he will win
behavior.whenRetreats: When he does not understand what is happening
behavior.onLoss: Takes it grimly. Does not turn aggressive
behavior.strategyChange: Only if an ally shows him a clearer path

motives.publicGoal: To win a decent sum and go home
motives.hiddenGoal: To win enough for his son's treatment
motives.betrayalTrigger: If someone threatens his son or lies to him badly
motives.helpTrigger: If he sees someone being cheated

speech.angerAndFear: Goes quiet and clenches his fists

mechanics.strangeness: The fire in the hearth leans towards him when he walks in — like towards an old friend.
mechanics.temptation: Does not understand political games and does not see complex traps
mechanics.ability: Anvil: once per evening his amulet stops a second death too.
mechanics.hostRelation: Ignorance — he thinks the host is just a rich innkeeper.

authorNotes.distinctive: An ordinary man in a world of intrigue, with an emotional motive.
authorNotes.immutable: The directness and the love for his son.
authorNotes.tunable: How easily he is fooled and how long he remembers a deception.

lines.text: Oswin. Smith. Don't mistake me for a lord.
Me? I never touched you, friend. Look at your own hands.
An alliance… fine. But lie to me and you'll regret it.
Knew it. Never trust a smooth tongue.
Hm. That's a lot… But my son needs it.
Oswin Miller, smith of Hemsby. An honest man. One wonders what he seeks at my table.
Tell the boy… his father tried.

tells.description: Goes quiet and clenches his fists
Drums his fingers on the table like a hammer
